item.title: Girls Basketball: Byron-Bergen edges Holley 34-28 on senior night
item.description: Byron-Bergen overcame a slow start to defeat Holley 34-28 on Thursday, finishing strong with a 15-point fourth quarter.Megan Jarkiewicz led the Bees with 10 points and 11 rebounds, hitting two three-pointers. item.description: A trailer fire was reported shortly after noon on Friday at 3322 Main Street Road, Batavia.The trailer was reportedly destroyed in the fire.East Pembroke Fire responded along with Pembroke and Corfu. A second alarm as later canceled. Reader-submitted photos.
